authority_posture: indexes governance decisions and dependencies; does not promote, downgrade, or mutate canon by itself
coverage_rule: Every governance manifest path and every top-level registry manifest path must eventually have a decision node, an edge to a decision node, or an explicit no-governance-decision classification.

contract_lock_refresh_rule.applies_when: A governance decision changes a file included by registry/contract-surface-registry.json.
required_sequence: Compute the contract surface hash from that committed substrate tree.
Refresh contracts.lock.json in each consumer repo.
Run contract-lock drift validation and each touched consumer repo's tests.
forbidden: Do not refresh consumer locks from an uncommitted substrate working tree.
contract_lock_refresh_rule.fail_closed_expectation: Contract-lock drift validation must fail when contract-surface paths are dirty.

coverage_layers.purpose: Classify every governance and registry manifest path.
Extract allowed values, booleans, thresholds, states, and global controls from registry JSON.
coverage_layers.expected_output: machine decision nodes and registry dependency edges

coverage_layers.purpose: Extract normative governance decisions from governance Markdown.
coverage_layers.expected_output: candidate prose decision nodes with source anchors

coverage_layers.purpose: Map sibling repo consumers, contract locks, validators, examples, commands, and docs.
coverage_layers.expected_output: consumer edges and likely impact statements

coverage_layers.purpose: Define safe branch-local or proposal-local governance setting experiments.
Resolve duplicates, authority status, and open conflicts before promotion.
coverage_layers.expected_output: reviewed node set or follow-up governance issues

likely_effects: Cross-repo gates, route selection, manifest closure, and smoke tests change first in the substrate.
Lock drift can block contract loading.
Route/event or reason-code changes alter classification and execution decisions.
Agent-hostile changes can reject tool/model flows.
Legal schema changes alter evidence/context packets.
Schema or route drift rejects events or quarantines packets.
Reason-code changes affect admission and defect output.
Mutation guard changes affect canon-write prevention.
Schema/export changes alter ingest preflight, bundle assembly, grounding, retrieval traces, safety checks, and anchored module discovery.
Lifecycle/scoring changes affect candidate status, quarantine, trust records, approvals, install/update audit behavior, and generated draft skills.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Authority precedence and conflict resolution
key_settings: source-of-truth precedes design-authority and downstream docs
runtime evidence and model output are evidence or proposals, not canonical truth
canonical meaning changes require reviewed promotion decisions
likely_change_effects: Changes alter conflict resolution across every governance and runtime consumer.
Runtime repos may need contract lock refreshes and boundary doc updates.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Experiment only as a proposal or branch-local alternate authority model; do not merge without human governance approval.

seed_decision_nodes.label: AI front-door read order, manifests, anchors, and endpoint metadata
key_settings: canonical_read_order
toc_required_substrings
integration_path_anchors
endpoint metadata required fields
likely_change_effects: Missing or stale anchors fail the AI front-door gate.
New governance or registry surfaces may require manifest updates.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Front-door experiments should add read-order or anchor entries in a branch and run the gate before broader mapping work depends on them.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Schema registry and schema-surface exclusion policy
key_settings: schemas under schemas/ must be registered or explicitly excluded
schema/ singular remains legacy or draft unless separately migrated
new Phase 2 schemas use grouped folders under schemas/
likely_change_effects: Schema placement or exclusion changes alter validator behavior and runtime contract expectations.
Premature promotion may lock unstable surfaces.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Use staged exclusions or draft registries for experiments; avoid duplicate authoritative schemas.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Exception route and event-class authority
key_settings: canonical route_id values
allowed event classes
approved learning path from exception evidence to promotion decision
likely_change_effects: Route or event changes require runtime mapping updates and evidence validation checks.
Invalid route/event combinations can block lake admission or decision packets.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Use candidate routes only in proposal form until substrate governance approves canonical route/event changes.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Runtime reason, admission, defect, and semantic mutation denial codes
key_settings: canonical reason-code values for runtime execution decisions
canonical admission and defect code families
semantic mutation deny-list values
likely_change_effects: Renamed or removed codes can fail imports, deny execution decisions, or change mutation-guard outcomes.
New codes require runtime loaders, tests, and docs to recognize them.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Treat code changes as high blast-radius vocabulary experiments; add runtime compatibility checks before merge.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Autonomy red/yellow/green policy and downgrade rules
key_settings: risk color controls authority
agents may downgrade green to yellow or red
only humans may create or restore non-preapproved green authority
likely_change_effects: Changing color thresholds changes allowed autonomy and escalation behavior.
Green restoration changes affect human finality and safety posture.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Experiment with stricter downgrades freely in branches; green restoration experiments require human decision modeling.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Harness intensity selection and red-flag response
key_settings: hardness controls harness depth
red flags require escalation and stronger validation
leverage controls priority, not authority
likely_change_effects: Higher harness levels increase validation load and review latency.
Lower harness levels may reduce evidence quality and safety margin.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Run as branch-local threshold simulations before changing active policy.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Human approval and external action finality
key_settings: protected or external side-effecting actions require authorized human approval
decision models define owner, alternatives, evidence minimums, reversibility, and approval
likely_change_effects: Approval rule changes alter side-effect authorization and audit burden.
Weaker approval rules increase risk of automation overreach.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Do not test external side effects from this repo; use decision packet simulations only.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Agent-hostile prompt/tool/endpoint/identity/revocation authority
key_settings: vendor adapters are consumers, not authorities
agent-callable endpoints require identity and audit controls
freeform downstream parsing is disallowed where policy says structured output is required
likely_change_effects: Tool or endpoint authority changes affect what agents may call and what audit evidence is required.
Prompt/model policy changes can alter routing, parsing, and provider lock-in risk.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Keep experiments provider-neutral and audit-preserving; do not let adapter prompts become canonical authority.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Legal knowledge, retrieval, access, and context bundle boundaries
key_settings: synthetic-only legal ingestion in current scope
no raw legal payload storage
access decisions apply before retrieval and answer rendering
context bundles preserve provenance and authority metadata
likely_change_effects: Changing ingestion or access rules affects legal runtime preflight and bundle assembly.
Relaxing raw payload restrictions would violate current repo boundary.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Use synthetic fixtures and metadata-only manifests; real legal payload experiments belong outside these repos under approved controls.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Skill-agent lifecycle, quality, graph, and workflow control plane
key_settings: every repo has skill-agent front-door files
skill/agent metadata is required
control-plane schemas are excluded from primary schema surface until graduation criteria are met
likely_change_effects: Lifecycle or scoring changes affect skill promotion, quarantine, and quality review.
Schema graduation changes primary schema surface obligations.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Use candidate scoring or lifecycle proposals before changing active lifecycle transitions.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Contract surface hashing, locking, and managed patch preservation
key_settings: consumer locks pin substrate contract surfaces
managed-patch decisions are excluded from surface hash to avoid recursive lock bumps
protected replacement, deletion, regeneration, and broad blast radius require decision records
likely_change_effects: Changing included/excluded surfaces can force lock refreshes.
Weakening preservation rules increases overwrite risk for protected docs.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Run lock and preservation changes in a clean multi-repo workspace; do not overwrite copied child folders.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Central CI and test routing authority
key_settings: central deterministic test router is substrate-owned
runtime repos provide local ci-test-manifest.json only
unknown changes fail closed
likely_change_effects: Router rule changes alter validation selection across the workspace.
Unknown or unregistered artifacts can block completion until classified.
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Keep routing experiments branch-local and prove affected test surfaces before reporting success.

seed_decision_nodes.label: Workflow atlas and research signal candidate boundaries
key_settings: candidate outputs may inform assessments but may not mutate canon
Research Radar sources are pre-PR07 draft scaffolding and non-authorizing
research signals may recommend downgrade but may not restore green
likely_change_effects: Formalizing candidate surfaces may add schema and runtime contract obligations.
Confusing candidates with canon would violate promotion boundaries.
validation_surfaces: front-door validation if paths are added
seed_decision_nodes.experiment_notes: Keep outputs metadata-only, local-only, and non-authorizing until PR07 or later governance promotion.
